data.name: Farahan
data.gender_notes: Farahan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'farahah' which means 'to be joyful, radiant, or to bring prosperity'. In Islamic tradition, Farahan is a name given to those who bring happiness and prosperity to their communities. The name Farahan carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant, or Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farahan usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant, or prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with joy and light, a beacon of happiness and prosperity.
data.etymology: Farahan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Radiant, or Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farahan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: فرحان
in_arabic.meaning: فرحان يعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرحان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الفرح والسرور والابتهاج، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية 170 'وَأَسْتَبْشِرُوا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ' حيث يبشر الله تعالى المؤمنين بالجنة و الفرح، ومن هنا تأتي أهمية الاسم ودلالته على الفرح والسعادة في الحياة

in_urdu.name: فرحان
in_urdu.meaning: فرحان کا مطلب ہے خوشی، مسرت اور شادابی
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرحان ایک مسلم اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی، مسرت اور شادابی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ خوشی اور سعادت کی علامت ہے۔ فرحان نام کا شخص خوش قسمت اور مسرت بخش سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़रहान
in_hindi.meaning: फ़रहान का अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और उल्लास
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़रहान एक इस्लामी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है खुशी, आनंद और उल्लास। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि यह सुख और समृद्धि का प्रतीक है। फ़रहान नाम के व्यक्ति को खुशनसीब और आनंददायक माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: فرحان

in_english.name: Farahan
in_english.meaning: Farahan means happiness, joy, and jubilation in English
in_english.long_meaning: Farahan is an Islamic name derived from Arabic roots, specifically from 'farḥ' (فَرِح) which means happiness, joy, and jubilation. The name has a strong Quranic background, appearing in Surah Al Imran verse 170, emphasizing the joy and bliss in paradise. Historically, the name Farahan signifies a person who brings happiness and cheerfulness. In modern Muslim cultures, Farahan is chosen for its beautiful meaning and spiritual significance, reflecting positive personality traits and good fortune

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta describes Farahan as a city of great importance during his travels in the 14th century. He mentions it as a major trading hub between the Indian Ocean and the Mediterranean.
historical_references.context: Ibn Battuta, a Moroccan traveler, visited the city of Farahan during his world journey.

historical_references.reference: Farahan was also known as the capital city of the Persian Empire in the early 7th century, during the reign of Khosrow I Anushirvan.
historical_references.context: Farahan was the political and cultural center of the Sassanid Empire during the rule of Khosrow I Anushirvan.
